rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to refer to the household's main income earner.

example.english: My mother raised us siblings on her own and was the breadwinner in our family.
example.traditional: 我阿媽一個人養大我哋幾兄弟，係屋企嘅養家嘅人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 jat1 go3 jan4 joeng5 daai6 ngo5 dei6 gei2 hing1 dai6 hai6 uk1 kei2 ge3 joeng5 gaa1 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the person is the family's main financial support.

example.english: My older brother supported all of us through school and was the family's breadwinner.
example.traditional: 哥哥供我哋幾兄弟讀書，係成頭家嘅經濟支柱。
example.jyutping: go1 go1 gung1 ngo5 dei6 gei2 hing1 dai6 duk6 syu1 hai6 sing4 tau4 gaa1 ge3 ging1 zai3 zi1 cyu5
